We perceive things based on our emotions. This means what we feel in that moment will influence our thoughts about it. We can turn negative to positive. One of our most underrated skills is how we can influence our emotions. A quick and simple system: Pause, Perspective, Perception. Pause: stop what you are doing. Perspective: question your thoughts, why do I feel this way. Perception: direct attention to the present and embrace a new side of calmness.

Commitment without intentionality becomes obligation, and obligation without a clear sense of why it is an obligation leads to a chaotic mental space. Obligations can either be imposed or chosen, and the ones we choose we need to consciously choose them, otherwise we teach ourselves that we aren't in control. For me right now: still being at my job is an obligation based on a previous choice I no longer make. Being with my partner is a choice I still make every day, that our relationship will endure, grow, evolve, and lead both of us to a better place. The audit doesn't just reveal what you're still choosing. It reveals what you're not choosing, and why. And what you aren't changing, you are choosing.
